rows.abstract: Rationale: In our country, school teachers are the major work force responsbile for molding our youth who will become our future leaders. rows.author: A061
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE BANGKO SENTRAL NG PILIPINAS TO REQUIRE ALL IMPORTERS AND OTHERS WHO NEED TO BUY DOLLARS TO POST IN ADVANCE A PESO DEPOSIT EQUIVALENT TO THEIR DOLLAR APPLICATION AND THAT ALL DOLLAR REMITTANCES OF OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS ANDEXPORTERS MUST BE CHANNELED THRU GOVERNMENT BANKS
rows.abstract: Rationale: To save the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas from this counter-product ive process and to equalize the playing fields, an offer as a solution requiring all importers and others who need to buy dollars for their business operations to post in advance a peso deposit equivalent to their dollar application and which can be used by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas as loan to small and medium scale businessmen. This will save the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas from using its borrowed money in buying rates for their operation. Also, all dollar remittances from our Overseas Filipino Workers and export earnings shall be channelled through government banks to control  the circulation and prevent the dollars from seeing their way to the money changgers and private banks who manipulate the foreign exchange leading to the downfall of the economy.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1997-08-04

rows.title_full: AN ACT REDUCING THE FINAL TAX ON ROYALTIES RECEIVED BY LOCAL BOOK AUTHORS FROM THE PRESENT TWENTY PERCENT (20%) TO TEN PERCENT (10%), AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SUBPARAGRAPH (1), PARAGRAPH (C), SECTION 21 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale: Royalties on books are taxed at the same rate as other kinds of royalties, such as those for the use or lease of antural resources, patents, manufacturing formulas, industrial or commercial equipment of knowledge, foreign technology, andothers. > If enacted into law, this proposal would encourage and give impetus to present and future writers to write books, and eventually would bring about the publication of more titles, thus ensuring the flourishing of the book publishing industryand materially in the family of nations.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A REFRIGERATED PLANT IN ALL CITIES AND MUNICIPALITIES IN THE COUNTRY, AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Rationale: Agriculture and marine products need to be stored in a cold storage facility prior to and during transport to the market. For areas where road networks are bad or no roads at all, storing agricultural and marine products in cold storage may mean earning profit for farmers and fishermen for their produce.  Cold storage preserve the freshness  of farm produce and  marine products.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1997-08-04

rows.author: A094
rows.title_full: AN ACT MAKING THE POSITION OF MUNICIPAL/CITY AGRICULTURAL OFFICERS MANDATORY AND FIXING THE COMPENSATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: Rationale: Section 482 of the Local Government Code has institutionaliz ed the position of the MUNICIPAL OR CITY AGRICULTURIST as a mechanism for the delivery of the afore-mentioned services.  In particular, the agriculturist formulates and implements agricultural programs, provides technical assistance, conducts research, promotes agricultural productivity and makes recommendations to the sanggunian on all matters relating to agriculture and aqua-culture. > However, despite the important roleof the municipal/city agriculturist , the Code has only made the said position optional, thereby rendering the delivery of devolved services uncertain. Declares, therefore, the following --- "Section 1. The position of municipal/city agricultural offficer shall be mandatory in every municipality or city as the case may be with a salary scale of Grade 24."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1997-08-04

rows.author: B050
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE GAWAD-SAKA INSURANCE FUND FOR BONAFIDE GAWAD-SAKA INDIVIDUAL AWARDEES, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale: The main objective of the Gawad-Saka Awards is to pinpoint or select the best representatives from our farmers and fisherfolks' cooperatives and other categories. Those chosen excel not only in productivity but are also involved in community work and are well-rounded individuals who epitomize the best farmer and fisherfolk. > Creates the GAWAD-SAKA INSURANCE FUND which will be used to purchase (1) life insurance, (2) death and (3) burial benefits for all bonafide awardees. Designatesthe NATIONAL STEERING COMMITTEE  for these awards as the implementing agency. Identifies the beneficiaries, amount of insurance, and prescribes penalties for violation of this proposed measure.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 1997-08-05
